```{r loading, echo = FALSE, message=FALSE}

# Load data 
load("timeseries_NEWDATA.RData")

# Load packages
if (!require(plyr)) {install.packages("plyr", dependencies = TRUE); require(plyr)}
if (!require(lsr)) {install.packages("lsr", dependencies = TRUE); require(lsr)}
if (!require(forecast)) {install.packages("forecast", dependencies = TRUE); require(forecast)}
if (!require(tseries)) {install.packages("tseries", dependencies = TRUE); require(tseries)}


```


```{r codeCreateSourceTS, include=FALSE}
## Check sources across all attitudes --------------


## AGE ----
table(timeseriesAge_NEW$brought_simp)/sum(table(timeseriesAge_NEW$brought_simp))

## Monthly frequencies
age.sourcedems <- as.data.frame(table(timeseriesAge_NEW$brought_simp, timeseriesAge_NEW$month.cent))
colnames(age.sourcedems) <- c("source", "month", "freq")
age.sourcedems$month <- as.numeric(as.character(age.sourcedems$month)) + 156
age.sourcedems$source <- factor(age.sourcedems$source, labels = levels(age.sourcedems$source))
age.sourcedemswide <- reshape(age.sourcedems, v.names = "freq", 
                       timevar = "month", idvar = "source",
                       direction = "wide")
age.sourcedemswideN <- colSums(age.sourcedemswide[,-1])
age.sourcedemswide[,-1] <- sweep(age.sourcedemswide[,-1], 2, age.sourcedemswideN, FUN = '/')


plot(age.sourcedems$freq[age.sourcedems$source == "assign"],
     type = "l", ylab = "Frequency", xlab = "Month Index", col = "darkred",
     ylim = c(0, 15000))
lines(age.sourcedems$freq[age.sourcedems$source == "search"], col = "darkblue")
lines(age.sourcedems$freq[age.sourcedems$source == "other"], col = "lightgrey")
legend("topleft", c("Assignment", "Search", "Other"),
       col = c("darkred", "darkblue", "lightgrey"),
       lty = 1, lwd = 4, bty = "n", ncol = 2)

plot(x = 1:c(ncol(age.sourcedemswide)-1), y = as.numeric(age.sourcedemswide[1,2:ncol(age.sourcedemswide)]),
     type = "l", ylab = "Relative Frequency", xlab = "", col = "darkred",
     ylim = c(0, 1), axes = FALSE)
box()
axis(1, at = seq(1, 48, by = 12), labels = c(2017:2020))
axis(2, at = seq(0, 1, by = 0.2), labels = seq(0, 1, by = 0.2))
lines(as.numeric(age.sourcedemswide[3,2:ncol(age.sourcedemswide)]), col = "darkblue")
lines(as.numeric(age.sourcedemswide[2,2:ncol(age.sourcedemswide)]), col = "lightgrey")
legend("topleft", c("Assignment", "Search", "Other"),
       col = c("darkred", "darkblue", "lightgrey"),
       lty = 1, lwd = 4, bty = "n", ncol = 2)


age.corsource <- list()
age.corsourcedat <- as.data.frame(matrix(nrow = 3, ncol = 4))
colnames(age.corsourcedat) <- c("att", "grp", "r", "p")
age.corsourcedat$att <- "age"
age.corsourcedat$grp <- age.sourcedemswide$source

for (i in 1:3){
  age.corsource[[i]] <- cor.test(as.numeric(age.sourcedemswide[i,2:ncol(age.sourcedemswide)]), 1:c(ncol(age.sourcedemswide)-1)) 
  age.corsourcedat$r[i] <- age.corsource[[i]]$estimate
  age.corsourcedat$p[i] <- age.corsource[[i]]$p.value
}




## Yearly frequencies
timeseriesAge_NEW$year <- paste("20", substr(timeseriesAge_NEW$month, start = 1, stop = 2), sep = "")

age.sourcedems_year <- as.data.frame(table(timeseriesAge_NEW$brought_simp, timeseriesAge_NEW$year))
colnames(age.sourcedems_year) <- c("source", "year", "freq")
age.sourcedems_year$year <- as.numeric(as.character(age.sourcedems_year$year))
age.sourcedems_year_wide <- reshape(age.sourcedems_year, v.names = "freq", 
                       timevar = "year", idvar = "source",
                       direction = "wide")
age.sourcedems_year_wideN <- colSums(age.sourcedems_year_wide[,-1])
age.sourcedems_year_wide[,-1] <- sweep(age.sourcedems_year_wide[,-1], 2, age.sourcedems_year_wideN, FUN = '/')


plot(age.sourcedems_year$freq[age.sourcedems_year$source == "assign"],
     type = "l", ylab = "Frequency", xlab = "", col = "darkred",
     ylim = c(0, 100000))
lines(age.sourcedems_year$freq[age.sourcedems_year$source == "search"], col = "darkblue")
lines(age.sourcedems_year$freq[age.sourcedems_year$source == "other"], col = "lightgrey")
legend("topleft", c("Assignment", "Search", "Other"),
       col = c("darkred", "darkblue", "lightgrey"),
       lty = 1, lwd = 4, bty = "n", ncol = 2)

plot(x = 1:c(ncol(age.sourcedems_year_wide)-1), y = as.numeric(age.sourcedems_year_wide[1,2:ncol(age.sourcedems_year_wide)]),
     type = "l", ylab = "Relative Frequency", xlab = "", col = "darkred",
     ylim = c(0, 1), axes = FALSE)
box()
axis(1, at = c(1:4), labels = c(2017:2020))
axis(2, at = seq(0, 1, by = 0.2), labels = seq(0, 1, by = 0.2))
lines(as.numeric(age.sourcedems_year_wide[3,2:ncol(age.sourcedems_year_wide)]), col = "darkblue")
lines(as.numeric(age.sourcedems_year_wide[2,2:ncol(age.sourcedems_year_wide)]), col = "lightgrey")
legend("topleft", c("Assignment", "Search", "Other"),
       col = c("darkred", "darkblue", "lightgrey"),
       lty = 1, lwd = 4, bty = "n", ncol = 2)

  dis.corsourcedat$r[i] <- dis.corsource[[i]]$estimate
  dis.corsourcedat$p[i] <- dis.corsource[[i]]$p.value
}
```

## Timeseries of sample sources
``` {r analyzeTStrends, echo = FALSE}
## Create vectors for subgroups ----
table(timeseriesAge_NEW$brought_simp)

sourceTSvecs <- function(sourceid, attitudedat){
  sourceTSvecdat <- ddply(attitudedat[attitudedat$brought_simp == sourceid,], .(month.cent), summarize, 
                       mean = mean(dscore), weight.mean = weighted.mean(dscore, weightvec), cohens = cohensD(dscore))
  
  sourceTSvec <- ts(sourceTSvecdat$weight.mean, frequency = 12, start = c(2017, 1), end = c(2020, 12))
  sourceTStrend <- decompose(sourceTSvec)$trend
  
  sourceTSvecout <- list(sourceTSvecdat, sourceTSvec, sourceTStrend)
  return(sourceTSvecout)
}

sourceids <- levels(timeseriesAge_NEW$brought_simp)

## AGE ----
age.sourceTSlist <- list()
age.sourceTSlisttrend <- list()
for(i in 1:3){
    age.sourceTSlist[[i]] <- sourceTSvecs(sourceid = sourceids[i], attitudedat = timeseriesAge_NEW)[[2]]
    age.sourceTSlisttrend[[i]] <- sourceTSvecs(sourceid = sourceids[i], attitudedat = timeseriesAge_NEW)[[3]]
}
```

# Print table for attitudes across groups
```{r tablOutput, echo=FALSE}
## CREATE TABLE ----
sourceattitudes_table <- as.data.frame(matrix(nrow = 6*2, ncol = 9))

colnames(sourceattitudes_table) <- c("att", "grp", "startatt", "endatt", "tdiff", "pdiff", "ddiff", "intb", "intp")

sourceattitudes_table$att <- rep(c("Age", "Race", "Skin-tone", "Sexuality", "Disability", "Weight"), each = 2)
sourceattitudes_table$grp <- rep(c("Assignment", "Search"), times = 6)

sourceattitudes_table$startatt <-round(c(age.sourceTSlisttrend[[1]][7], age.sourceTSlisttrend[[3]][7],
                                     race.sourceTSlisttrend[[1]][7], race.sourceTSlisttrend[[3]][7],
                                     skin.sourceTSlisttrend[[1]][7], skin.sourceTSlisttrend[[3]][7],
                                     sex.sourceTSlisttrend[[1]][7], sex.sourceTSlisttrend[[3]][7],
                                     dis.sourceTSlisttrend[[1]][7], dis.sourceTSlisttrend[[3]][7],
                                     weight.sourceTSlisttrend[[1]][7], weight.sourceTSlisttrend[[3]][7]), 2)
sourceattitudes_table$endatt <-round(c(age.sourceTSlisttrend[[1]][42], age.sourceTSlisttrend[[3]][42],
                                     race.sourceTSlisttrend[[1]][42], race.sourceTSlisttrend[[3]][42],
                                     skin.sourceTSlisttrend[[1]][42], skin.sourceTSlisttrend[[3]][42],
                                     sex.sourceTSlisttrend[[1]][42], sex.sourceTSlisttrend[[3]][42],
                                     dis.sourceTSlisttrend[[1]][42], dis.sourceTSlisttrend[[3]][42],
                                     weight.sourceTSlisttrend[[1]][42], weight.sourceTSlisttrend[[3]][42]), 2)

sourceattitudes_table$tdiff <- round(rep(c(as.numeric(toverall_age$statistic),
                                                          as.numeric(toverall_race$statistic),
                                                          as.numeric(toverall_skin$statistic),
                                                          as.numeric(toverall_sex$statistic),
                                                          as.numeric(toverall_dis$statistic),
                                                          as.numeric(toverall_weight$statistic)), each = 2), 2)
sourceattitudes_table$pdiff <- round(rep(c(as.numeric(toverall_age$p.value),
                                                          as.numeric(toverall_race$p.value),
                                                          as.numeric(toverall_skin$p.value),
                                                          as.numeric(toverall_sex$p.value),
                                                          as.numeric(toverall_dis$p.value),
                                                          as.numeric(toverall_weight$p.value)), each = 2), 2)

sourceattitudes_table$ddiff <- round(rep(c(cohend_age, cohend_race, cohend_skin,
                                                      cohend_sex, cohend_dis, cohend_weight), each = 2), 2)

sourceattitudes_table$intb <- round(rep(c(as.numeric(summary(age.timelm)[["coefficients"]][4,1]),
                                          as.numeric(summary(race.timelm)[["coefficients"]][4,1]), 
                                          as.numeric(summary(skin.timelm)[["coefficients"]][4,1]), 
                                          as.numeric(summary(sex.timelm)[["coefficients"]][4,1]), 
                                          as.numeric(summary(dis.timelm)[["coefficients"]][4,1]),
                                          as.numeric(summary(weight.timelm)[["coefficients"]][4,1])), each = 2), 3)

sourceattitudes_table$intp <- round(rep(c(as.numeric(summary(age.timelm)[["coefficients"]][4,4]),
                                          as.numeric(summary(race.timelm)[["coefficients"]][4,4]), 
                                          as.numeric(summary(skin.timelm)[["coefficients"]][4,4]), 
                                          as.numeric(summary(sex.timelm)[["coefficients"]][4,4]), 
                                          as.numeric(summary(dis.timelm)[["coefficients"]][4,4]),
                                          as.numeric(summary(weight.timelm)[["coefficients"]][4,4])), each = 2), 2)


knitr::kable(sourceattitudes_table,
             col.names = c("Attitude", "Group", "Starting Attitude (2017)", "Ending Attitude (2020)",
                           "t Difference", "p Difference", "d Difference",
                           "Interaction b", "Interaction p"))
```
